top_signals.title: Stocks, Bonds Fall as Data Keep Fed Bets in Play: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Stocks joined bonds lower after the latest batch of economic reports did little to alter bets the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates before the year is over.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
